name: Sticks to Snake
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level sorcerer/wizard 3, cleric/oracle 3, summoner 3, druid 3, magus 3, witch 3, antipaladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bundle of medium sticks)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target bundle of sticks
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance none

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as per sticks to snakes, except as follows. Instead of the bundle transforming into many small snakes the bundle merges and transfigures itself into either one anaconda constrictor snake or an emperor cobra snake.
